rules.name: MERGE
rules.meaning: content from two sources merged into one event

rules.name: SOURCE
rules.meaning: speaker changed user<->assistant<->tool; system->user/developer lowering is D02

rules.name: FLAG
rules.meaning: semantic flag lost / invented / moved: is_error and its per-dialect carriers, redacted/thinking presence, strict on a tool

rules.name: REINTERP
rules.meaning: payload re-interpretation (typed JSON <-> string, nested result flattened)

rules.name: CONTENT
rules.meaning: non-empty content event lost or invented: text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, image, server-tool blocks; empty blocks -> R05

rules.name: REF
rules.meaning: reference broken: tool_result->tool_call, Responses call_id/item ids, ids exceeding documented length/charset

rules.name: ORDER
rules.meaning: causal partial order violated across edge families E1-E5, with sibling tool_results unordered (R07)

rules.name: CONTROL
rules.meaning: a control the source SET is dropped or changed without a documented equivalent carrier

rules.name: TOOLNAME
rules.meaning: tool name altered

rules.name: INTEGRITY
rules.meaning: integrity token replaced by a value the vendor did not issue in this conversation (provenance check)

rules.name: SCHEMA
rules.meaning: tool JSON-Schema structural/constraint change after schemacanon normalisation

rules.name: STOP
rules.meaning: stop/finish reason semantic class changed or missing on the terminal event

rules.name: STREAM
rules.meaning: stream accounting: reassembled content != non-stream equivalent, delta after stop, start/stop pairing broken, tool input outside carrier, is_error on delta

rules.name: CONTROL-DEFAULT
rules.meaning: control injected by adapter default where source unset

rules.name: LOWER
rules.meaning: system->user/developer lowering although the target has a system slot

rules.name: HINT
rules.meaning: cache_control / service_tier / prompt-cache hints dropped or mis-mapped

rules.name: USAGE
rules.meaning: usage numbers changed, leaked, or missing initial output_tokens

rules.name: MODEL
rules.meaning: model echo/name changed

rules.name: ENVELOPE-LEAK
rules.meaning: reserved keys of another dialect leaking or duplicated stop_reason

rules.name: NULLABLE
rules.meaning: absent vs null on nullable required keys

rules.name: EMPTYSTR
rules.meaning: empty string vs null content beside tool calls

rules.name: TEXTFORM
rules.meaning: string vs 1-element array; adjacent text coalesced/split with same concatenation

rules.name: CUSTOMKEY
rules.meaning: unknown custom keys

rules.name: EMPTYBLOCK
rules.meaning: empty text block/part/delta injected

rules.name: ANNOTATION
rules.meaning: schema annotation keys changed

rules.name: SIBLING
rules.meaning: sibling tool_result order within one parallel group changed

rules.name: ENVELOPE-ID
rules.meaning: envelope identifiers changed
